niche: Megalophobia / Extreme Water Sports / Speed POV
visual_prompt: Cinematic 9:16 vertical video. Terrifying first-person GoPro POV. (0-4s) The viewer is sitting on a small riverboard at the absolute edge of a colossal, 1,000-foot concrete mega-dam spillway. The bottom of the dam is completely obscured by dense white mist and thick valley fog, creating a horizonless, terrifying vertical drop. Millions of gallons of water are rushing past, creating a slick ramp. (4-8s) The stomach-dropping free-fall begins as the board hits the angled concrete. (8-12s) Extreme, violent acceleration. High-frequency camera shake mimicking a fiberglass board vibrating on wet concrete. The concrete walls blur into gray streaks with heavy motion blur. Heavy water violently sprays the camera lens. (12-15s) The board hits the transition curve at the bottom at 100+ MPH, launching the rider hundreds of feet into the air over the raging white-water river below. Hyper-realistic, 4k resolution, overcast stormy lighting, high-contrast HDR.

editor_script.4-8s: Once you drop in, there is no going back.
editor_script.style: Industrial, heavy block typography in stark white with deep blue water-stain overlays, vibrating slightly with the camera shake.

audio_script.0-4s: Deafening, heavy roar of massive water flow + deep concrete bass rumble
audio_script.4-8s: Scraping sound of a fiberglass board on wet concrete + wind starting to pick up
audio_script.8-12s: Violent, roaring wind distortion + frantic splashing sounds masking the audio
audio_script.12-15s: Sudden audio suspension (slow-motion airborne silence) + massive splash impact sound on landing

caption:
